ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; primary surface consists of low-intensity black pixels with high-intensity white pixel clusters covering approximately 8-10% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous black base with discrete, high-contrast white circular/rosette clusters (approx. 5-25 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes, increasing in density towards the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees; notch depth is well-defined and centrally located.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (3-15 pixels) along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes, creating a continuous jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted from the medial notch to the distal tips, exhibiting a standard elliptical arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial distribution of circular white pixel clusters (barnacles/scarring) across both the left and right ventral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of barnacle-related rosette scars and active encrustation; heavy cluster of calcified organisms at the distal tips of both lobes.
